detailed_task_description: This workflow opens a web browser and navigates to Swiggy to place a food delivery order. It searches for a specified restaurant, opens the restaurant page, and uses the in-restaurant search to locate a desired dish. It then selects variants/customizations (defaulting to cheaper options when choices are presented) and adds the item to the cart. Finally, it opens the cart and selects the saved delivery address (A2) to proceed toward checkout.

task_params.name: restaurant_name
task_params.description: Restaurant name to search for on Swiggy.

task_params.name: menu_search_query
task_params.description: Search term used within the restaurant page to find the desired dish/item.

success_criteria: Verify Swiggy cart/checkout shows the selected items added and the delivery address is set to A2.

subtasks.text: Launch Chrome and navigate to Swiggy homepage. Expected outcome: Swiggy.com is open and ready for interaction.

steps.expected_current_state: macOS desktop showing the wallpaper and top menu bar; no application window is focused and desktop icons are visible.
steps.intent: Open the system Spotlight search so the user can type a query.

target.primary: Any area of the macOS desktop (no window focused), with the menu bar visible at the top

post_action: A Spotlight search bar appears near the top-center of the screen.
A search text field is focused and ready for typing.

steps.expected_current_state: macOS desktop with Spotlight search active; a dark rounded Spotlight Search text field is visible near the top-center of the screen and ready for typing.
steps.intent: Search for and open the Chrome browser using Spotlight.

target.primary: Spotlight Search text field (dark rounded search bar) near the top-center of the screen showing the placeholder 'Spotlight Search'.
target.fallback: search bar near the top-center of the desktop

post_action: The Spotlight field now contains the entered text.
A browser application window is brought to the foreground.

steps.expected_current_state: Chrome browser window is open showing the AI Mime homepage; the browser tab bar and address bar are visible at the top of the window with one or more tabs open.
steps.intent: Open a new browser tab so the user can navigate to a different page.

target.primary: New-tab button (plus '+' icon) in the browser's tab bar near the right side of the open tabs (top area of the window).

post_action: A new browser tab appears in the tab bar.
The tab bar shows an additional (empty) tab to the right of the existing tabs.

steps.expected_current_state: A Chrome browser window is open showing the AI Mime website in a tab; the browser tab bar is visible across the top with multiple tabs.
steps.intent: Open a new browser tab.

target.primary: Plus icon (+) New Tab button in the browser tab bar near the right of the open tabs

post_action: A new browser tab opens and becomes the active tab.
The browser displays the new tab page and focus moves to the new tab.

steps.expected_current_state: Chrome browser open on a new tab / Google start page. The browser's top address bar (omnibox) is visible at the top of the window and ready for input.
steps.intent: Type the website URL into the browser's address bar to navigate to that site.

target.primary: Top address bar / omnibox in the Chrome window showing 'Search Google or type a URL' (near the top center of the window).
target.fallback: Center search box on the Google start page labeled 'Search Google or type a URL' (middle of the page).

post_action: The address bar now contains the entered text and the browser began navigating the active tab.
The page content area started loading for the requested site.

steps.expected_current_state: Web browser window with the tab labeled 'swiggy.com' selected; the tab content area is blank/dark (Swiggy page not yet rendered).
steps.intent: Submit the URL / trigger the browser to load the Swiggy homepage so the site renders.

target.primary: Browser address bar / omnibox near the top of the window (tab shows 'swiggy.com')

post_action: The Swiggy homepage loads and page content becomes visible.
A central search/address input and other site UI elements appear.

subtasks.text: Search for the restaurant {restaurant_name} on Swiggy and open its restaurant page. Expected outcome: The selected restaurant page is open with its menu visible.

steps.expected_current_state: Browser open on Swiggy homepage (hero landing) with a large orange background; a centered search bar with placeholder text is visible and the location selector is to its left.
steps.intent: Open the search view so the user can search for restaurants or food items.

target.primary: Centered search input with placeholder text 'Search for restaurant, item or more' (large search bar near the middle of the page)
target.fallback: Magnifying-glass search icon inside/right side of the same center search bar

post_action: The site navigates to the search page with an expanded search input near the top.
Recent searches and popular cuisine options become visible below the search input.

steps.expected_current_state: Swiggy search page in a browser window with a prominent search input near the top center, recent searches listed below, and the search input focused and ready for typing.
steps.intent: Enter the restaurant name into the search box to find matching restaurants for delivery.

target.primary: Search input near the top center with placeholder text 'Search for restaurants and food' and a magnifying-glass icon to the right

post_action: The search input displays the entered query.
The results area refreshes to show matching restaurants or a loading/results list.

steps.expected_current_state: On the Swiggy search/results page showing the search header and a results area with two pill-style tabs near the top (one for Restaurants and one for Dishes); the results area currently shows loading/placeholder content.
steps.intent: Switch the results view to show restaurant listings instead of dishes by selecting the Restaurants tab.

target.primary: Pill/tab labeled "Restaurants" near the top-left of the results area, directly to the left of the "Dishes" pill

post_action: The results area updates from loading placeholders to populated restaurant cards.
Restaurant tiles (image, name, rating/summary) become visible in the results list.

steps.expected_current_state: In a web browser on the Swiggy search/results page showing restaurant result cards; the 'Brik Oven - Original Sourdough P...' result card is visible near the top of the results.
steps.intent: Open the Brik Oven restaurant page to view its details and menu for ordering.

target.primary: Result card near the top with the restaurant name text 'Brik Oven - Original Sourdough P...' (thumbnail image on the left, name and brief details on the right).

post_action: The app navigates to the restaurant's detail page showing the full restaurant header and ordering options (Order Online / Dineout).

subtasks.text: Search within the restaurant menu for {menu_search_query} and open the target item to begin customization. If there are not customisations, the items will be directly added to the cart. Expected outcome: The item customization flow/modal is opened for the matching item or the item being added to the cart

steps.expected_current_state: Restaurant page open in a browser showing 'Brik Oven - Original Sourdough Pizzas' with the 'Order Online' tab active, visible 'Deals for you' cards, a 'Search for dishes' bar near the center, and a floating 'MENU' button in the lower-right.
steps.intent: Scroll the restaurant page downward to reveal more menu items and recommendations.

target.primary: Main content area (center column) containing the restaurant header, 'Deals for you' cards, and the 'Search for dishes' bar — scroll this central content.

post_action: The page content moves down to reveal sections lower on the page.
Lower elements such as menu filters and the 'Recommended (18)' area become visible.

steps.expected_current_state: Restaurant ordering page open in a browser, showing the restaurant header, a 'Deals for you' row, the 'Search for dishes' bar, and the top of the menu in the central scrollable content area.
steps.intent: Scroll the restaurant page down to reveal more of the menu and the Recommended section.

target.primary: Central scrollable page content (the main restaurant menu area) containing 'Deals for you' and the 'Search for dishes' bar, near the center of the window

post_action: The page content has moved down (the view scrolled).
Additional menu items and the 'Recommended' section become visible below the search bar.

steps.expected_current_state: Browser is on a restaurant menu page showing deals and a 'MENU' section; a rounded search field with placeholder 'Search for dishes' is visible in the center of the page above the list of recommended items.
steps.intent: Open the restaurant's search input to search for dishes.

target.primary: Rounded search field with placeholder text 'Search for dishes' under the 'MENU' section (magnifying-glass icon at the right end).
target.fallback: Magnifying-glass icon button at the right end of the search field.

post_action: Search view/header opens with a focused search input.
Main menu content is replaced by an empty search/results area.

steps.expected_current_state: Swiggy restaurant page open in a browser showing a centered search input near the top of the content area; the search box is visible and empty, ready for text entry.
steps.intent: Enter a search query into the on-page search box to find matching items or restaurants.

target.primary: Search input box with placeholder text near the top center of the page (search field with a magnifying glass icon)
target.fallback: search input field near top center of the content area

post_action: The search field becomes populated and the page updates to show search results.
Relevant items or a results list are displayed below the search area.

subtasks.text: Complete item variant/customization selections (if it is open) (prefer cheaper variants) and add the configured item to the cart. Expected outcome: The item appears in the cart (cart count/summary reflects the added item). Skip this step using done if item is already added and customisation is not needed

steps.expected_current_state: Browser window with a restaurant customization modal open titled 'Customise as per your taste'. The modal shows variant radio options (Medium selected) and a green 'Continue' button along the bottom.
steps.intent: Submit the selected variant and proceed by clicking the Continue button.

target.primary: Green 'Continue' button at the bottom of the 'Customise as per your taste' modal (right side of the modal footer).

post_action: The Continue button is clicked (receives click feedback).
The customization step is submitted and the app proceeds (modal will advance/close).

steps.expected_current_state: A restaurant item customization modal is open in the browser (titled 'Customise as per your taste'), showing size variant options (Medium and Large) with prices and a green action button at the bottom of the modal.
steps.intent: Choose the cheaper variant (smaller size) and continue to proceed with adding the item.

target.primary: Green button labeled 'Continue' located at the bottom-right of the 'Customise as per your taste' modal

post_action: The Continue button was clicked and the selection was submitted.
The UI should proceed from the customization modal (modal is dismissed or the next step begins).

steps.expected_current_state: Web browser open to a food-ordering site with a centered 'Customise as per your taste' modal dialog. The dialog shows 'Choose From Variant' options (size radio buttons) and a green action button labeled 'Continue' in the modal footer.
steps.intent: Advance past the variant selection to the next customization step.

target.primary: Green 'Continue' button in the bottom-right area of the customization popup (popup footer).

post_action: The customization modal advances to the next view showing add-ons/options for the chosen variant.
A new footer action appears (green 'Add Item to cart' button) and the add-ons list is visible.

steps.expected_current_state: A product customization modal is open over the restaurant page showing pizza size and add-on options, with the price visible at the bottom and the primary action button at the bottom-right. A pizza base option has not been selected.
steps.intent: Add the configured pizza to the shopping cart.

target.primary: Green rounded button labeled 'Add Item to cart' located at the bottom-right of the customization modal

post_action: A validation/error tooltip appears in the modal indicating a required selection is missing.
The item is not added to the cart and the modal remains open for correction.

steps.expected_current_state: A browser window with a restaurant/product customization modal open titled 'Customise as per your taste'; the modal shows size selection, a scrollable 'Choose From Add Ons Veg for Medium' list with checkboxes, price at the bottom, and an 'Add Item to cart' button.
steps.intent: Scroll the add-ons list in the customization modal to reveal more topping options or the lower customization sections.

target.primary: The scrollable add-ons list inside the center customization popup (section with the header 'Choose From Add Ons Veg for Medium')
target.fallback: the scrollable area of the customization modal in the center of the screen

post_action: The add-ons list content is scrolled, showing different add-on items or lower parts of the modal.
More of the modal's lower content becomes visible.

steps.expected_current_state: A restaurant item's customization modal is open over the restaurant page. The modal shows the 'Customise as per your taste' header and a visible list of add-on options for the selected size; the bottom of the modal content is partially off-screen.
steps.intent: Scroll the customization modal content to reveal the pizza base selection section.

target.primary: Scroll inside the open customization modal (the centered dialog titled 'Customise as per your taste'), focusing on the modal's main content area where add-ons are listed.

post_action: The modal content has moved, revealing the 'Choose Your Pizza Base' section and its selectable options.
More of the lower modal content (base options and related controls) is now visible.

steps.expected_current_state: Browser showing a Swiggy restaurant page with a centered, focused customization modal overlay titled 'Customise as per your taste' containing toppings and a 'Choose Your Pizza Base' options list; background is dimmed.
steps.intent: Scroll the customization modal to reveal more option checkboxes and bring the pizza base choices into view.

target.primary: The scrollable customization modal content area (the central white rounded box) titled 'Customise as per your taste'.
target.fallback: The options list region under 'Choose Your Pizza Base' inside the modal.

post_action: The modal content shifted vertically so different option checkboxes moved into view.
Visible options under the pizza base section changed position (additional checkboxes are now visible).

steps.expected_current_state: A product customization modal is open on the Swiggy webpage showing sections like 'Customise as per your taste' and 'Choose Your Pizza Base', with multiple base options listed and a green 'Add Item to cart' button visible at the bottom.
steps.intent: Select the 'Sourdough Regular - Medium' pizza base option so it becomes chosen.

target.primary: The selectable radio/checkbox control to the right of the 'Sourdough Regular - Medium' option inside the 'Choose Your Pizza Base' section of the open customization modal.

post_action: The 'Sourdough Regular - Medium' base is marked selected (radio/checkbox shows a checked state).
The customization modal remains open with the 'Add Item to cart' button still visible.

steps.expected_current_state: A restaurant/menu page is open in a browser and a product customization modal is displayed in the foreground (dimming the page). The modal shows pizza customization options, price at the bottom, and a large green action button near the modal's bottom edge.
steps.intent: Add the customized pizza to the cart.

target.primary: Green button with text 'Add Item to cart' located at the bottom of the customization modal
target.fallback: green rounded action button near the bottom-right of the open customization dialog

post_action: The customization modal closes.
The cart UI updates and a bottom cart bar appears showing the added item and total.

subtasks.text: Open the cart and select the saved delivery address A2. Expected outcome: Delivery address is set to A2 and the order is ready to proceed to payment/review.

steps.expected_current_state: Web browser on a restaurant menu/listing page. One item has been added to the cart and a green cart summary bar is visible along the bottom-right showing the item count and total price (e.g., '1 Item | ₹410').
steps.intent: Open the cart to proceed to checkout and view the order summary.

target.primary: Green 'VIEW CART' button in the bottom-right corner of the page on the cart summary bar (shows item count and total price).

post_action: The checkout/cart page is opened.
The screen shows delivery address selection and the order summary with bill details on the right.

steps.expected_current_state: Checkout page showing 'Select delivery address' with a saved address card labeled 'A2' on the left and an 'Add New Address' card to the right; the A2 card displays a green 'DELIVER HERE' button.
steps.intent: Choose the saved A2 address for delivery.

target.primary: The green 'DELIVER HERE' button inside the A2 address card (left side of the address selection area).

post_action: The A2 address is selected for delivery.
Checkout advances toward the next step (payment/confirmation) and the selection state is updated in the UI.

steps.expected_current_state: Checkout page on the 'Select delivery address' step showing saved addresses. A saved address card labeled 'A2' is visible on the left with a prominent green 'DELIVER HERE' button; order summary is shown in a side panel on the right.
steps.intent: Select the displayed saved address to deliver the order to that location.

target.primary: Green 'DELIVER HERE' button inside the saved-address card labeled 'A2' (left side of the address selection area)
target.fallback: Button with text 'DELIVER HERE' in the saved address card area

post_action: The saved address is marked/selected as the delivery address.
The checkout advances toward the next step (the payment section or confirmation becomes the next focus).
